faq.q: Is client-confidential data safe with Ryu?
faq.a: Yes. With a local model, client-confidential content stays on your machine. For cloud models, Gateway rules can block or redact personal data and log each call. Analytics and crash reports are on by default and can be turned off.

faq.q: Can it cite the source documents?
faq.a: Yes. Add your clause library and matter files to a Space; the agent searches them and can quote the document and passage it used, so a human can verify before relying on it.

faq.q: Is this a replacement for a lawyer?
faq.a: No. Ryu drafts and researches; a qualified professional checks every output.
